content.heroText: Celebrations, weddings and portraits that feel like the people in them, plus sports and live performances, photographed by Alan Luby across South Florida.
content.marqueeText: Events · Weddings & engagements · Portraits · Sports · Live performance ·
content.servicesText: Five kinds of work, one approach: be prepared, stay attentive, and let people be themselves.
content.aboutText1: Alan Luby has photographed banquets and conventions, weddings and birthdays, games and stage performances, and portrait sessions at home, outdoors and at work. That range shapes how he works.
content.aboutText2: He arrives prepared, keeps to your schedule, and puts people at ease so expressions stay natural. At an event he watches for the laugh, the embrace and the reaction between the planned moments. At a game or a show, experience with fast action helps him anticipate the peak of a play, a leap or a lyric.
content.storyHeading: From “she said yes” to the walk down the aisle
content.storyText: Alan photographed this couple’s save-the-date session and then their wedding day. The first was relaxed and playful, with plenty of room to laugh at the camera. The second meant reading the room: the ceremony schedule, the light, and the glance between them as they made their entrance.
content.closingTitle: Planning an event, a wedding, a portrait session, a game or a performance?
content.closingText: Tell Alan what you have in mind: the occasion, the date if you have one, and where it takes place.

about.seoDescription: Alan Luby is a Boynton Beach photographer with over 30 years of experience photographing events, weddings, portraits, sports and live performances.

content.heading: Alan Luby photographs people at their best moments.
content.bio1: I'm a freelance photographer who currently resides in Boynton Beach. I am a member of the Black Chamber of Commerce of Palm Beach County a former member of ASMP The American Society of Media Photographers. I have been hired to cover events by the Miami Herald, Palm Beach Post, South Florida Times, South Florida Sun-Sentinel, the Associated Press and numerous other publications. I have over 30 years of photography experience and was the team photographer for the Florida Bobcats of the Arena Football League and the Florida Beachdogs of the Continental Basketball Association.
content.bio2: As a freelance photographer I have had the opportunity to cover the Miami Dolphins, Miami Heat, Miami Marlins, University of Miami, President Barack Obama, the victory party for Florida Gov. Rick Scott and numerous other news, sports and feature assignments for various publications.
content.bio3: I’m also a portrait and wedding photographer that has done event photography with on-site printing for Motorola, American Society of Kidney Patients, Palm Beach State College, Big Brothers, Big Sisters of Palm Beach County, BB King's and numerous other profit and not-for-profit organizations.
content.careerHeading: Ready for the moment that matters
content.careerText: Alan’s years covering news for South Florida publications included photographing President Barack Obama. That experience of working fast, in crowds and under pressure, is the same calm he brings to events today.
content.approach1Text: He plans around your schedule and arrives ready, so the day runs smoothly.
content.approach2Text: Relaxed direction helps portrait subjects and guests stop worrying about the camera.
content.approach3Text: The laugh, the embrace and the reaction often happen between the planned moments.
content.approach4Text: Careful editing keeps skin tones and colors true to the day.

content.intro: Alan photographs people at their occasions and weddings, in portraits, in competition and on stage. Here is what each kind of coverage includes and how to start a conversation about yours.

content.step2Text: Alan talks through the schedule, the people who matter most and the moments you want covered.
content.step3Text: Alan arrives prepared and works quietly around your program, session, game or show.
content.step4Text: You receive edited, color-corrected digital images, ready to share and print.
